purpose: Pure interval/QC/count/selector component tests. Synthetic byte strings and integer token labels are authored geometry, not a substitute v3 grammar/corpus, observed vocabulary, native pack or runtime result.

API.cases: Exact tuple of1..96 exact-key dicts: id,ordinal,raw_bytes,native_byte_eligible,generation_member,semantic_eligible. id is unique nonempty scalar string<=128characters; ordinal strictint equals its tuple index0..n-1; raw_bytes exactbytes length1..1024; three flags exactbool. No measured membership/outcome/path fields.
API.ledgers: Exact tuple parallel to cases. Each entry is None or exact-key dict token_ids,piece_byte_lengths,piece_hex. Each array is an exact tuple; token IDs/lengths strictints, hex strings canonical lowercase even-length hexadecimal including empty. Fixture JSON lists are converted to tuples by the test caller only.
API.vocabulary_size: Strict int1..262144; synthetic fixtures use100, never an actual model observation.
API.eog_ids: Exact sorted unique tuple of1..64 strictints in[0,vocabulary_size); synthetic fixtures use(99,).
API.fatal_input_errors: Raise ValueError without partial analysis for invalid case/outer-ledger/vocabulary/EOG schema/types/caps/identity/order. In particular shuffled, duplicate or noncontiguous ordinals raise ValueError('case_order'); do not sort. Per-case malformed ledgers instead yield explicit QCunknown as specified.
API.return: Immutable ordinary result with to_dict() returning a fresh JSON-shaped dictionary as specified below. No file/codec-vocabulary/network/native operation, input mutation or source authentication is provided. Ordinary immutability is not hostile-Python isolation.

QC.population: Derive only native_byte_eligible AND generation_member AND semantic_eligible. Never use actual grammar outcomes or QCsuccess to remove a source-declared population case.
QC.declared_harness: native_byte_eligibleFalse requires ledgerNone; qc_status=harness_ineligible,qc_reason=harness_declared,measured counts/matrix/boundaries/zero count=None. Its global contribution is known0 by declaration, not measured absence. A supplied ledger is QCunknown/harness_ledger_present, still outside declared population.
QC.eligible_checks: Check raw full document strictUTF8 and no literalNUL; exact ledger schema/array types; equal array lengths; N<=min(65536,4*B+32); IDs0..vocabulary_size-1 and no EOG; canonical hex and stated length equality with every length<=B; sumlengths==B and exact concatenation==raw. Preserve every original token ordinal including empty pieces. Do not decode an individual piece as standalone UTF8.
QC.failure: Any failed eligible check yields qc_status=unknown with finite reason, boundaries/counts/matrix/zero_piece_count=None. Reasons used by isolated fixtures are missing_ledger,roundtrip,ordinary_EOG,token_id. No clipping, fallback or zero normalization. Other isolated shape failures may use descriptive finite reasons.
QC.scope: QCchecks validate caller-provided geometry only; they neither tokenize nor authenticate that a model emitted a ledger.

geometry.scalar_intervals: Compute strict scalar intervals in the full raw document. LiteralNUL/invalidUTF8 are never accepted eligible raw inputs.
geometry.boundary: Every token ordinal gets start/end from cumulative lengths. Only a nonempty piece[a,b) with0<b<B and scalar[s,e) satisfying s<b<e qualifies; zero pieces and document-end boundaries have no candidate pending interval/classes/witnesses.
geometry.mixed: A wholly-contained complete interval[u,v) satisfies a<=u<v<=s. Completing a scalar started beforea does not count. Return distinct complete widths sorted1..4, each with its earliest-start interval; repeats of a width count once.
geometry.counts: Dictionary with exactly the four classes, nonnegative integers. Width category is e-s; mixed increments once if any contained whole scalar exists.
geometry.matrix: 4by3 JSON list matrix: rows complete widths1,2,3,4; columns pending widths2,3,4. Each boundary increments once per distinct contained complete width. Matrix sum may exceed mixed count.
geometry.per_case: Valid eligible ledgers have actual geometry counts/matrix even outside declared coverage population. Only source-declared population contributions enter global counts.

result_shape.cases: Frozen-order list of exact-key records id,ordinal,population,qc_status,qc_reason,zero_piece_count,boundaries,counts,matrix. qc_status is ok,harness_ineligible,unknown; ok reasonNone. Harness/unknown measurement fields areNone. Every valid eligible boundary is retained, including nonpopulation cases.
result_shape.boundary_values: pending_start/end are integers only for qualifying candidates, otherwiseNone; complete_widths/witnesses/classes are empty for noncandidates. witnesses is a width-sorted list of triples[width,start,end]. classes follows classes_order.
result_shape.global_complete: coverage_completeTrue iff every source-declared population case has qc_statusok. all_case_QC_completeTrue iff every case is ok or expected harness_ineligible. These are analysis completeness flags, not profile acceptance.
result_shape.counts_and_matrix: Sum population geometry only when coverage_complete; otherwiseNone. known_*_lower_bound always sums currently knownok population cases, explicitly not complete totals when unknown population exists.
result_shape.unknown_population_ordinals: Ascending list of ordinals with populationTrue and QCunknown. An excluded QCunknown case is retained in cases/all_case_QC_complete but cannot make a declared-zero population contribution unknown.
result_shape.selectors: When coverage_complete, exact four-class dictionary mapping each class to its selected_prefixes index orNone for a knownzero class. Otherwise entire selectors=None; no first boundary asserted while an earlier population case is unknown.
result_shape.selected_prefixes: When complete, list de-duplicated by(caseordinal,tokenordinal), allocated in class-priority order. Each class chooses lexicographically first qualifying population boundary. Entry exactkeys case_ordinal,token_ordinal,take_tokens,byte_cut,classes; take_tokens=j+1 includes empty tokens, byte_cut=end, classes lists all boundary geometry labels. OtherwiseNone.
result_shape.required_available: None when incomplete; otherwise bool(all four global counts>0). False means known coverage unavailable, distinct from unknown. EvenTrue grants no grammar/profile/native qualification.

bounds_and_wire_limit: Same source profile maxima96cases/B1024/Ncap4128, no increase to117/120/300seconds/256MiB. Pure result may retain all boundary objects; native64KiB rows need only complete piece arrays+compactcounts and<=4selected witness rows. No native row-fit, general streaming/resource complexity or runtime statement follows from these component vectors.
fixture_encoding: Vector JSON uses raw_hex in case descriptors; test caller replaces it with raw_bytes=bytes.fromhex(raw_hex), preserves order and converts arrays/outercollections to tuples. Token integers are synthetic labels. Expected return dictionaries are authored from literal byte intervals, not generated by the analyzer or any tokenizer.
prohibitions: No profile qualification or old-gate repair
